notes.title: Major Update 1.0.2!
notes.content:
Hello Archers!
We have prepared a Major Update 1.0.2, check that you have Save 2020 actualized.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/f255c4c698acaa5883f9afa8b88cd1b6ecfeafd2.png[/img]

[b]List of Actualizations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Main Menu Full Screen bug Fixed.
[*] New SFX when the Archer receives damage.
[*] Loading Screen Fixed.
[*] New Animations for Dark Soldiers.
[*] Signs in the "Cave" have changed positions to improve player experience.
[*] Controller feel Improved.
[/list]

notes.title: New localization for Save 2020 - Save 2020 on 8 different languages!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We know there is archers all around the world, that's why you can play Save 2020 now in your native language!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/5c8496755117fc534ce8c79fec9aa14b6f62f9ad.png[/img]

New Languages:  
[list]
[*] English               
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] Portuguese
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] Chinese
[*] Japanese
[/list]

What are you waiting for 🏹
